description: You are the HR Manager at a mid-sized technology company. The executive team has announced that the 'R&D USA' sub-department is being dissolved as part of a consolidation initiative — all its engineers are to be folded into the main 'Research & Development' department under unified leadership. Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Your tasks are: (1) Find every employee currently assigned to the 'R&D USA' department and move them to 'Research & Development'. (2) Set 'Marc Demo' as the direct manager for each of those transferred employees. (3) Archive the 'R&D USA' department once it has no remaining active employees. You are not told which employees are in R&D USA — you must discover this yourself.
